text.11:72: She said: Oh woe is me! Shall I bear a child when I am an old woman, and this my husband is an old man? Lo! this is a strange thing!
text.19:15: Peace on him the day he was born, and the day he dieth and the day he shall be raised alive!
text.19:33: Peace on me the day I was born, and the day I die, and the day I shall be raised alive!
text.37:152: Allah hath begotten. Allah! verily they tell a lie.
text.58:2: Such of you as put away your wives (by saying they are as their mothers) - They are not their mothers; none are their mothers except those who gave them birth - they indeed utter an ill word and a lie. And lo! Allah is Forgiving, Merciful.
text.71:27: If Thou shouldst leave them, they will mislead Thy slaves and will beget none save lewd ingrates.
text.90:3: And the begetter and that which he begat,
text.112:3: He begetteth not nor was begotten.
